reason: A more directly tests the proposed mediator—oxide-film stability—under simultaneous wear–corrosion and includes localized interphase corrosion, film-spallation measurements, and a clearer falsification criterion; B’s corrosion-only baseline cannot distinguish true synergy from the trivial added loss caused by wear. A still requires refinement because pre-treatment/alloying may confound the comparison, and a NaCl solution is not a physically valid environment at 900°C (a defined molten-salt or chloride-vapor atmosphere is needed).
